scripts._comment:pretest: The browser tests run against dist, which `build:release` deliberately builds without the harness — so an e2e run after a release build silently tested an app with no fixture in it, and every test timed out waiting for a row. Building first is cheap and removes the trap.
scripts.test:ui: playwright test tests/layout.spec.ts tests/keyboard.spec.ts tests/browse.spec.ts tests/operations.spec.ts tests/context.spec.ts tests/archives.spec.ts tests/thumbnails.spec.ts tests/network.spec.ts tests/memory-columns.spec.ts tests/places-of-memory.spec.ts tests/sidebar.spec.ts tests/controls.spec.ts tests/architecture.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:ui && npm run test:perf
